html:
Ottoman Hungary was the central part of the Kingdom of Hungary ruled by the Ottoman Empire from the taking of Buda in 1541 until the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699.

After the defeat at Mohács in 1526, Hungary was split three ways: the Ottomans held the centre with Buda as a provincial capital, the Habsburgs held a strip in the north and west, and Transylvania became a principality under Ottoman protection. Constant border war drained the plains of people and villages. The Ottomans built mosques, minarets and Turkish baths in Buda and Pécs, some still in use. Habsburg armies retook Buda in 1686 after the failed siege of Vienna of 1683, and the whole country came under the Habsburgs by 1699.
sum: Ottoman Hungary was the central part of the Kingdom of Hungary ruled by the Ottoman Empire from the taking of Buda in 1541 until the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699.
